add.name: Eastern Catholic churches
add.summary: Eastern churches in full communion with the pope that keep their own liturgies, clergy, and church law. The largest, the Ukrainian Greek Catholic Church, came out of the Union of Brest in 1596.

facts: There are 23 Eastern Catholic churches alongside the Latin Church.
The Maronites of Lebanon confirmed their ties with Rome in 1182.
Many of them ordain married men as priests.
Each uses an Eastern rite such as Byzantine, Syriac, or Coptic.
add.sacraments: Seven sacraments, often called holy mysteries. Infants receive baptism, chrismation, and first communion together. The Byzantine rite uses leavened bread.
